title: Which residues can survive the wheel?
hook: Which residues can survive the wheel? Follow the computed steps.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Integer remainders, gcd, primes, modular exponentiation.
doesNotKnow: Skip candidates sharing small prime factors using a repeating residue wheel.

misconception: A prime search must test every odd number even after excluding multiples of three.
objective: Skip candidates sharing small prime factors using a repeating residue wheel.

claims.text: Coprime residues repeat with the wheel period, skipping numbers divisible by its small primes. Surviving means candidate, not proved prime: the witness deliberately counts one and other composite survivors.
